script_text: Pisces, this week the cosmos is rewriting your story — and it starts with a bang. Early week, Mercury in your 10th House squares Neptune, your ruling planet, creating fog around career decisions Monday through Tuesday — avoid signing contracts or making big moves until clarity arrives. Wednesday shifts everything: Venus trines your 10th House, opening a golden window for financial negotiations and professional recognition. Mid-week, the Sun conjuncts Jupiter in your 11th House, amplifying your social magnetism and bringing unexpected support from friends. Late week, Mars enters your 5th House Thursday through Sunday, igniting passion in love — a romantic spark you've been waiting for finally catches fire. Saturday is your power day because the Sun-Jupiter conjunction peaks in your 11th House, bringing abundance and connection. Monday is your worst day because Mercury square Neptune clouds your judgment in career matters. Trust your water-sign intuition this week, Pisces — your emotions are your compass. Follow for daily updates.
